user.title: Glass Task Board
user.description: Adds a board for recurring household tasks. The glass card is loaded automatically — add it to a dashboard as "Glass Task Board".

abort.already_configured: The task board is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: The task board is already set up.

init.title: Overdue reminders
init.description: For each person, pick the notify service(s) that should remind them when one of their tasks is overdue (for example notify.mobile_app_pixel). Tasks for "Everyone" remind every person below. People added on the board itself are set up in the card's People screen.

data.notify_everyone: Extra services for tasks that are everyone's job
data.notify_url: Open this dashboard path when a reminder is tapped (e.g. /lovelace/tasks)

complete.name: Mark task done
complete.description: Mark a task as done, as if someone tapped it on the board.

task.name: Task
task.description: The task's name (for example "Feed the dog") or its id.

by.name: Done by
by.description: The person who did it (a person entity or a board member id). Leave empty to use whoever ran this.

undo.name: Undo last done
undo.description: Take back the most recent time a task was marked done.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Add a recurring task to the board.

title.name: Name
title.description: What needs doing, for example "Water the plants".

repeat.name: Repeats
repeat.description: Every day, on certain days of the week, or every few days counted from when it was last done.

days.name: Days of the week
days.description: For "certain days". 0 is Monday, 6 is Sunday.

times.name: Due by
times.description: One or more times of day, like 08:00 and 18:00. Leave empty for "any time that day".

assignee.name: Whose job
assignee.description: everyone, a person entity or a board member id.

notify.name: Remind when overdue
notify.description: Send phone reminders when the task is overdue.

delete_task.name: Remove task
delete_task.description: Remove a task from the board.

set_background.name: Set background
set_background.description: Switch the board's colour theme on every screen. Use a preset, or "custom" with three colours.

preset.name: Theme
preset.description: One of the eleven presets, or "custom".
